pageDesc: Remote desktop: multi Linux-user VNC sessions, noVNC in the browser, and outbound client profiles.
executeOn: YSK_EXECUTE is on — install, useradd, and sessions can apply when root.
executeOff: YSK_EXECUTE is off — status is live, but install / Linux users / sessions stay blocked until enabled.
accountsEmptyDesc: Use Create account to add a Linux user and VNC session.
clientPathHint: Connect via the server (noVNC proxy) or via your own network (vncviewer / direct RFB).
clientEmptyDesc: Import a remote host:port in a later PR. Choose via-server or direct path when connecting.
installHint: Install TigerVNC first, then noVNC for browser access. XFCE is optional (larger download).
needTigerVnc: TigerVNC server is required for multi-user sessions
needNovnc: noVNC + websockify for browser remote desktop
needViewer: Optional TigerVNC viewer (this host as client, direct path)
needViewerOrNovnc: Viewer or noVNC recommended for client tab
settingsHint: Defaults apply to new accounts. Changing RFB bind to “all interfaces” exposes ports — prefer localhost + noVNC or VPN.
autostartLabel: Start VNC session on boot (when applied)
accountListDesc: Each account is a separate Linux user and TigerVNC display.
createAccountDesc: Creates a dedicated Linux user (yskvnc_*) and VNC session settings.
passwordHint: Optional on create; min. 6 characters. Written with vncpasswd when root+EXECUTE.
passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 6 characters
startAfterCreate: Start session after create (needs root + YSK_EXECUTE)
deleteAccountDesc: Remove control-plane account {{name}} ({{user}}). Session will be stopped first.
deleteAccountC3User: Linux user home will be removed (userdel -r)
deleteAccountC3Keep: Linux user will be kept on the system
removeLinuxUser: Also remove Linux user and home directory
connectionPathsHint: Prefer via server (noVNC on localhost). Direct RFB needs bind=all + firewall.
directLocalhostWarn: RFB is localhost-only — change bind to all interfaces for direct internet clients, or use SSH tunnel / noVNC.
